title: Vice President, Deputy General Counsel
descriptionHtml:
HackerOne is a global leader in Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). The HackerOne Platform unites agentic AI solutions with the ingenuity of the world’s largest community of security researchers to continuously discover, validate, prioritize, and remediate exposures across code, cloud, and AI systems. Through solutions like bug bounty, vulnerability disclosure, agentic pentesting, AI red teaming, and code security, HackerOne delivers measurable, continuous reduction of cyber risk for enterprises. Industry leaders, including Anthropic, Crypto.com, General Motors, Goldman Sachs, Lufthansa, Uber, UK Ministry of Defence, and the U.S. Department of Defense, trust HackerOne to safeguard their digital ecosystems. HackerOne was recognized in Gartner’s Emerging Tech Impact Radar: AI Cybersecurity Ecosystem report for its leadership in AI Security Testing and has been named a Most Loved Workplace for Young Professionals (2024).

HackerOne is at a pivotal inflection point in the security industry. Offensive security is no longer optional – it is the standard for forward-thinking companies that want to build trust and resilience in a world where AI-driven innovation and adversaries are moving faster than ever. With the industry shifting, HackerOne stands apart: we combine the ingenuity of the largest security research community with a best-in-class AI-powered platform, trusted by the world’s top organizations.

HackerOne Values

HackerOne is dedicated to fostering a strong and inclusive culture. HackerOne is Customer Obsessed and prioritizes customer outcomes in our decisions and actions. We Default to Disclosure by operating with transparency and integrity, ensuring trust and accountability. Employees, researchers, customers, and partners Win Together by fostering empowerment, inclusion, respect, and accountability.

Associate General Counsel - Global Commercial Lead

Remote Locations

USA: Seattle, San Francisco Bay Area, Austin, Washington DC, or Boston

UK: London

Position Summary

HackerOne is redefining offensive security for the AI era. As organizations accelerate digital transformation and AI innovation, trust has become the ultimate competitive advantage. We combine the world's largest community of security researchers with an AI-powered platform trusted by global enterprises and governments.

We are seeking a Vice President, Deputy General Counsel to lead our global commercial legal function and own our global privacy portfolio. Reporting to the Chief Legal Officer and serving on the Legal leadership team, you will set how Legal enables revenue growth, international expansion, strategic partnerships, and AI-driven product innovation.

This is a scale role with a hands-on core. You will personally carry the most complex commercial and data protection matters while building the standards, systems, and team that let the function grow across North America, EMEA, and APAC.

At HackerOne, we embrace a Flexible Work approach that gives us the freedom to do our best work while also fostering the connections and community that make us stronger. Reflecting this philosophy, this is a remote role targeted for candidates within ~50 miles of any of the above locations. We believe this balance of proximity and flexibility gives Hackeronies the chance to occasionally come together – fostering collaboration, connection, and in-person moments that enrich our culture – while still preserving the benefits of remote work.

What You Will Lead

Global Commercial Legal

  • Shape global commercial legal strategy with the CLO, aligned to growth priorities, risk posture, and international expansion.

  • Maintain enterprise-wide risk standards, escalation paths, and negotiation frameworks that support speed and disciplined decisions.

  • Serve as senior decision authority on commercial legal risk within established thresholds.

  • Advise on our most complex transactions, including global enterprise agreements, regulated-industry engagements, channel partnerships, and public-sector opportunities.

Global Privacy

  • Own the global privacy program and serve as senior decision authority on data protection risk, including cross-border transfers, sub-processor terms, and impact assessments.

  • Partner with Security, Engineering, and Product to embed privacy by design into platform and AI capabilities, and lead the privacy workstream of incident response.

Executive Partnership and Risk Governance

  • Advise leaders across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Product, Security, Procurement, and GTM Operations.

  • Surface material commercial and privacy risks to the CLO and executive team with clear options, tradeoffs, and recommendations.

  • Work with GTM leadership to improve deal velocity and build scalable approaches to recurring customer requirements.

  • Guide the organization through regulatory and market change with Change Agility, and translate strategy into measurable outcomes, demonstrating Own the Outcome at an enterprise level.

.Team Leadership and Legal Operations

  • Lead and develop a multi-jurisdictional team across commercial, privacy, and procurement legal support, and recommend the structure and resourcing to support long-term growth.

  • Maintain a consistent service-delivery model with clear intake, service levels, and escalation.

  • Implement an AI-Native approach to legal operations, improving contract review, drafting, knowledge management, and workflow automation.

  • Apply First Principles Problem Solving to legacy processes, and use Data-Driven Decision Making to track contract cycle time, negotiation outcomes, risk concentration, privacy review throughput, and workload.

Minimum Qualifications

  • UK/EU or US qualified lawyer.

  • 15+ years of legal experience, including significant in-house leadership in technology or SaaS.

  • Experience managing a commercial legal function or major sub-function.

  • Extensive experience negotiating complex, cross-border enterprise agreements.

  • Deep working knowledge of applicable privacy laws.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building global legal infrastructure in high-growth environments.

  • Experience implementing legal technology and AI-enabled workflow tools.

  • Experience managing external counsel budgets and vendor risk governance

Compensation Bands

USA

  • Tier A (San Francisco Bay Area)

    • $280,000 to $320,000 + equity

  • Tier B: (Seattle, Austin, Washington DC, Boston)

    • $250,000 to $285,000 + equity

#LI-KM1

Job Benefits:

  • Health (medical, vision, dental), life, and disability insurance*

  • Equity stock options

  • Retirement plans

  • Paid public holidays and unlimited PTO

  • Paid maternity and parental leave

  • Leaves of absence (including caregiver leave and leave under CO's Healthy Families and Workplaces Act)

  • Employee Assistance Program

*Eligibility may differ by country

We're committed to building a global team! For certain roles outside the United States, India, the U.K., and the Netherlands, we partner with Remote.com as our Employer of Record (EOR).

Visa/work permit sponsorship is not available.

Employment at HackerOne is contingent on a background check.

HackerOne is an Equal Opportunity Employer in the terms and conditions of employment for all employees and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, pregnancy, disability or veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by international, federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all HackerOne employment practices, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. HackerOne makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

For US based roles only: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, all qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for the position.
